This collection includes multiple vintage writing and calligraphy pen sets with various accessories. It features a Classic Pen Set in a black hard case containing stainless steel pens, colored ink refills, mechanical pencil leads, and additional tips. 283330634.description:
Natural Quartz & Rose Quartz Mineral Specimen Lot
Raw Earth-Mined Crystals, Points & Rough Chunks
Total Weight: 6.4 lbs
This natural mineral collection features a diverse assortment of quartz specimens totaling approximately 6.4 pounds. Centered around a substantial raw rose quartz rough piece displaying delicate pink coloration and natural crystalline fracturing, the collection also includes an array of clear quartz points, clusters, and raw fragments. Valued by mineral collectors, lapidary crafters, and crystal enthusiasts, these pieces highlight the distinctive geometry and natural clarity characteristic of quartz minerals.
Prominent rough rose quartz specimen measuring approximately 4.5 inches across
Clear quartz crystal points with visible terminations and prismatic striations
Assorted crystalline clusters, rough chunks, and smaller crystal shards
Total collection weight of 6.4 pounds
Acrylic risers shown in photographs are for display and not included
Condition:
Very good overall condition with average wear. Specimens feature natural crystalline growth lines, rough cleavage faces, and internal inclusions typical of raw minerals. Minor surface abrasions and natural edge chipping consistent with unpolished stones.
